# SNMP Template & Profile Context

This file is the authoritative reference for the LLM that generates new SNMP
device templates and profiles for LogstashUI. It is generated automatically from
the bundled JSON files in `SNMP/data/` and committed to the repository.

**Do not edit this file by hand.** Re-generate it with:
```
uv run python manage.py generate_template_profile_context
```

---

## Section 1 — Device Templates

Each device template groups one or more profiles together under a single
vendor/product identity. The `profiles` list contains the names of the profiles
that are included in this template. `matching_rules` are case-insensitive
substrings matched against a device's `sysDescr` for auto-assignment.

> When generating a **new device template**, choose a unique `name` in
> `snake_case`, set appropriate `vendor`/`product`/`model` fields, list the
> profile names the template should include, and provide at least one
> `matching_rules` entry if the target device exposes a recognisable `sysDescr`.

### brocade_fc_switch

```json
{
  "name": "brocade_fc_switch",
  "description": "FC switch system metrics, per-port telemetry, and fabric name server for Brocade FC switches.",
  "vendor": "Brocade",
  "product": "FC Switch",
  "model": "Any",
  "matching_rules": [
    "Fabric OS",
    "FabricOS"
  ]
}
```

## Section 2 — Full Profile Catalog

Complete listing of every official profile. Profiles define which SNMP OIDs
to collect and how to post-process the values (normalizers).

**Profile JSON schema:**
- `name` — unique snake_case identifier (e.g. `cisco_system_metrics`)
- `description` — one sentence describing what is collected
- `vendor` / `product` / `model` — target device scope (`"Any"` for generic profiles)
- `get` — map of `"ecs.field.path": "OID"` for scalar GETs
- `walk` — map of `"ecs.field.path": "OID"` for SNMP walks
- `table` — map of table names → `columns` map of `"column_name": "OID"`
- `normalizers` — optional list of post-processing operations (see Section 3)

> When generating a **new profile**, choose a `name` prefixed with the vendor
> (or `generic_` for broadly applicable profiles), use ECS-aligned dot-notation
> field names, and add `normalizers` where raw SNMP values need conversion.

```json
        "in_discards": "1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.6.2.1.1.7",
        "in_errors": "1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.6.2.1.1.8",
        "out_octets": "1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.6.2.1.1.10",
        "out_errors": "1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.6.2.1.1.13"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Section 3 — Normalizer Reference

Normalizers are post-processing steps declared in the `normalizers` array of a
profile. They run after OID collection to transform raw SNMP values into usable
metrics.

**Scope rules:**
- `"scope": "get"` — runs on scalar GET results before table processing
- `"scope": "table"` — runs on per-row table results; `field` paths must include
  the table name prefix (e.g. `interface.admin_status`, not just `admin_status`)

### `multiply` — Multiply value

Multiplies a numeric SNMP value by a configured number. Useful for converting raw SNMP values into the expected unit.

```json
{
  "label": "Multiply value",
  "description": "Multiplies a numeric SNMP value by a configured number. Useful for converting raw SNMP values into the expected unit.",
  "applies_to": [
    "get",
    "table"
  ],
  "has_target_field": true,
  "inputs": {
    "multiply_value": {
      "type": "float",
      "default": 1.0,
      "description": "The value to multiply the SNMP value by."
    }
  }
}
```

### `translate` — Map values

Maps raw SNMP values to human-readable strings. Useful for integer status codes and enumerations (e.g. 1 -> UP, 2 -> DOWN).

```json
{
  "label": "Map values",
  "description": "Maps raw SNMP values to human-readable strings. Useful for integer status codes and enumerations (e.g. 1 -> UP, 2 -> DOWN).",
  "applies_to": [
    "get",
    "table"
  ],
  "has_target_field": true,
  "inputs": {
    "mapping": {
      "type": "key_value_pairs",
      "description": "Mappings (e.g. '1' -> 'UP', '2' -> 'DOWN')."
    }
  }
}
```

### `average` — Average column

Computes the average of a numeric table column across all rows and writes the scalar result to the metrics document (event.category: metrics). Does not affect individual row events.

```json
{
  "label": "Average column",
  "description": "Computes the average of a numeric table column across all rows and writes the scalar result to the metrics document (event.category: metrics). Does not affect individual row events.",
  "applies_to": [
    "table"
  ],
  "has_target_field": true,
  "inputs": {
    "output_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "required": true,
      "description": "Metrics-doc field to write the average to (e.g. 'interface.avg_in_octets')."
    },
    "multiply_value": {
      "type": "float",
      "default": 1.0,
      "description": "Optional multiplier applied to the averaged result before writing (e.g. 0.01 to convert a 0-100 percentage to a 0.0-1.0 decimal)."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ratio` — Calculate ratio

Derives ratios from two input fields. Any two of {used, free, total} are sufficient to compute all percentages.

```json
{
  "label": "Calculate ratio",
  "description": "Derives ratios from two input fields. Any two of {used, free, total} are sufficient to compute all percentages.",
  "applies_to": [
    "get",
    "table"
  ],
  "has_target_field": false,
  "inputs": {
    "value1_field": {
      "type": "field_selector",
      "description": "First field (e.g., system.memory.actual.used.bytes)"
    },
    "value2_field": {
      "type": "field_selector",
      "description": "Second field (e.g., system.memory.actual.free.bytes)"
    },
    "total_output_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Field to store value1 + value2. Leave empty to skip."
    },
    "ratio1_output_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Field to store value1 / (value1 + value2). Leave empty to skip."
    },
    "ratio2_output_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Field to store value2 / (value1 + value2). Leave empty to skip."
    },
    "complement_ratio_output_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Field to store (value1 - value2) / value1. Leave empty to skip."
    },
    "divide_output_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Field to store value2 / value1. Leave empty to skip."
    }
  }
}
```
